SETTINGS_SOURCE: The campaign settings of mordheimer.net (https://mordheimer.net/docs/campaigns/campaign-settings), as kept in the project: the ids are the slugs of its pages and the ones the items of the catalogue name in `settings`. The summaries are the project's own words. The new app only – legacy does not load the file.

SETTINGS.name: Core rules
SETTINGS.summary: The setting of the rulebook: the ruins of Mordheim, wyrdstone and the warbands that come for it. What the core price chart lists is available in every campaign.

SETTINGS.name: Border Town Burning
SETTINGS.summary: A frontier town on the edge of the Empire, near the borders of Cathay: caravan raids, hidden objectives, roaming ogres and Chaos-worshipping warbands, with the influence of the Eastern lands.

SETTINGS.name: Empire in Flames
SETTINGS.area: Villages, forests and castles of the Empire
SETTINGS.summary: The war spreads from the city into the open country: burning buildings, raids on settlements and ambushes in the wilderness instead of fights in ruined streets.

SETTINGS.name: Khemri
SETTINGS.area: Nehekhara, the deserts and the ruined necropolis of Khemri
SETTINGS.summary: Treasure hunters and mercenaries in the scorching deserts of Nehekhara: tombs, sandstorms, undead guardians, extreme heat, quicksand and cursed relics.

SETTINGS.name: Lustria
SETTINGS.summary: Warbands in the steamy jungles of Lustria, lured by gold and ancient artefacts instead of wyrdstone: dangerous terrain, tropical disease, venomous creatures and the Lizardmen.

SETTINGS.name: Albion
SETTINGS.summary: An island of eternal fog, standing stones and druidic magic: warbands seek monoliths full of untapped power, against harsh weather, swamps, magical storms and native warriors.

SETTINGS.name: The Nemesis Crown
SETTINGS.area: The Great Forest of the Empire
SETTINGS.summary: A powerful artefact lies buried in the Great Forest: warbands search the dense woods for it, with special movement rules, hidden trails and encounters with beasts and bandits.

SETTINGS.name: The Procession of Morr
SETTINGS.area: The Death's Head district of Mordheim
SETTINGS.summary: A campaign in Mordheim's Death's Head district, once known for its executions and the road to the Temple of Morr: thieves' guilds, death cults and restless spirits among the ruins.
